### object:Container

Register id: `layout-object:container`. Probe: `{"op":"read:layout","name":"My Layout for TestTable","detail":true}` selecting `**objects[id=23]`.

**Not reported**

| Attribute | Known from | SaXML path |
|---|---|---|
| object type | SaXML LayoutCatalog @type; Layout mode > Insert > Field on a container field. fm collapses Container into the plain field control: it reports type "field" and control "editBox", exactly what a text Edit Box reports, so a Container object cannot be told from an Edit Box in fm 0.6.0 (verified: Ooe object 23 is type="Container" in the export and reads back control "editBox") | `@type` |
| number of decimal places | SaXML LayoutCatalog ExtendedAttributes/Formatting/Numeric/DecimalDigits; Inspector > Data > Data Formatting > Number > Fixed decimal digits | `ExtendedAttributes/Formatting/Numeric/DecimalDigits` |
| number data-formatting options word | SaXML LayoutCatalog ExtendedAttributes/Formatting/Numeric/Options; Inspector > Data > Data Formatting > Number (format as decimal / currency / percent, notation, negative style, thousands separator) | `ExtendedAttributes/Formatting/Numeric/Options` |
| colour for negative numbers | SaXML LayoutCatalog ExtendedAttributes/Formatting/Numeric/Style/Negative/Color; Inspector > Data > Data Formatting > Number > Format as: negative values in colour | `ExtendedAttributes/Formatting/Numeric/Style/Negative/Color` |
| colour for negative numbers, alpha channel | SaXML LayoutCatalog ExtendedAttributes/Formatting/Numeric/Style/Negative/Color@alpha; Inspector > Data > Data Formatting > Number > negative-value colour | `ExtendedAttributes/Formatting/Numeric/Style/Negative/Color@alpha` |
| colour for negative numbers, blue channel | SaXML LayoutCatalog ExtendedAttributes/Formatting/Numeric/Style/Negative/Color@blue; Inspector > Data > Data Formatting > Number > negative-value colour | `ExtendedAttributes/Formatting/Numeric/Style/Negative/Color@blue` |
| colour for negative numbers, green channel | SaXML LayoutCatalog ExtendedAttributes/Formatting/Numeric/Style/Negative/Color@green; Inspector > Data > Data Formatting > Number > negative-value colour | `ExtendedAttributes/Formatting/Numeric/Style/Negative/Color@green` |
| colour for negative numbers, red channel | SaXML LayoutCatalog ExtendedAttributes/Formatting/Numeric/Style/Negative/Color@red; Inspector > Data > Data Formatting > Number > negative-value colour | `ExtendedAttributes/Formatting/Numeric/Style/Negative/Color@red` |
| date and time data-formatting options word | SaXML LayoutCatalog ExtendedAttributes/Formatting/Time/Options; Inspector > Data > Data Formatting > Date and Time (format, separators, leading characters, 12/24 hour) | `ExtendedAttributes/Formatting/Time/Options` |
| local style overrides (the object’s own CSS) | SaXML LayoutCatalog LocalCSS; Inspector > Appearance, any property changed away from the style (the style name then shows a change marker). fm decodes exactly one property out of this body — text-align, reported as textAlign (verified on Text object 81) — and reports none of the colours, borders, fonts, sizes or underline | `LocalCSS` |
| style kind (named theme style vs local override) | SaXML LayoutCatalog LocalCSS@type; Inspector > Appearance: ThemeCustomStyle means the object wears a named style, ObjectCustomStyle means it carries an unnamed local override. fm reports style only in the first case, so the second case is invisible | `LocalCSS@type` |
| number of tab-order entries | SaXML LayoutCatalog TabOrder@membercount; Layout mode > View > Tab Order (the numbered order of entry objects) | `TabOrder@membercount` |
| tab-order entry | SaXML LayoutCatalog TabOrder/Location; Layout mode > View > Tab Order | `TabOrder/Location` |
| tab-order position | SaXML LayoutCatalog TabOrder/Location@id; Layout mode > View > Tab Order | `TabOrder/Location@id` |

## read:relation

### relation

Register id: `relation`. Probe: `{"op":"read:relation","id":1}`.

**Not reported**

| Attribute | Known from | SaXML path |
|---|---|---|
| sort related records: put blanks last | SaXML RelationshipCatalog LeftTable/SortSpecification@blanksLast; Manage Database > Relationships > Edit Relationship > Sort records > Specify Sort Order; fm reports that a sort exists (rightToLeft.sortRelated) but nothing inside the specification | `LeftTable/SortSpecification@blanksLast` |
| sort related records: keep records sorted | SaXML RelationshipCatalog LeftTable/SortSpecification@maintain; Manage Database > Relationships > Edit Relationship > Sort records > Specify Sort Order; part of the sort specification fm does not report | `LeftTable/SortSpecification@maintain` |
| sort specification value flag | SaXML RelationshipCatalog LeftTable/SortSpecification@value; Manage Database > Relationships > Edit Relationship > "Sort records" and its Specify Sort Order sheet. NOT the sort-on flag: fmai's RELATION_CLAIMS (measured 2026-08-27 with both legs exercised) records sortRelated:true written back as <SortSpecification value="False" maintain="True"> and sortRelated:false as no element at all, so @value tracks something else inside the specification. It reads "True" on both Ooe relationships that have the element, which is the only leg this file exercises, and fm reports nothing that follows it. | `LeftTable/SortSpecification@value` |
| number of sort fields | SaXML RelationshipCatalog LeftTable/SortSpecification/SortList@membercount; Manage Database > Relationships > Edit Relationship > Sort records > Specify Sort Order — how many fields the sort uses (3 on relationship 2); fm reports no part of the sort's field list | `LeftTable/SortSpecification/SortList@membercount` |
| sort direction | SaXML RelationshipCatalog LeftTable/SortSpecification/SortList/Sort@type; Manage Database > Relationships > Edit Relationship > Sort records > Specify Sort Order — Ascending / Descending / custom order per field | `LeftTable/SortSpecification/SortList/Sort@type` |
| sort field | SaXML RelationshipCatalog LeftTable/SortSpecification/SortList/Sort/PrimaryField/FieldReference@name; Manage Database > Relationships > Edit Relationship > Sort records > Specify Sort Order — the field the related records are sorted on | `LeftTable/SortSpecification/SortList/Sort/PrimaryField/FieldReference@name` |
| relationship tags | SaXML RelationshipCatalog TagList; Manage Database > Relationships > Edit Relationship (object tags; FileMaker Pro offers no control for them and fm reports none on a relationship, unlike a table occurrence, where it reports tags) | `TagList` |
| last modified by account | SaXML RelationshipCatalog UUID@accountName; the DDR modification record (the Edit Relationship dialog shows no per-object audit) | `UUID@accountName` |
| last modified timestamp | SaXML RelationshipCatalog UUID@timestamp; the DDR modification record | `UUID@timestamp` |
| last modified by user name | SaXML RelationshipCatalog UUID@userName; FileMaker Pro Settings > General > User Name, recorded on the change | `UUID@userName` |

    "step": "Set Variable",
    "uuid": "C2594792-FC10-45A7-B548-B8B5795B14B6",
    "name": "$MBS_Command_Results",
    "value": "/*Let([ \r$Command_EN =_Syntax::Command_EN ;\r$Command_Foreign = Syntax.GUISyntax::Command ;\r$CommandColoringOn = _Syntax::On = 1;\r$ColorExists = Syntax.Color::__ID > 0 and Syntax.Color::ColorName ≠ \"--None--\";\r$ColorHex = Syntax.Color::_kColorHex ;\rvStamp = Get( CurrentTime )\r];\rCase( \r\r_Syntax::_kIsGroupTitle ; \"\" ;\r\rnot $CommandColoringOn or not $ColorExists ;\rvStamp & \" Removed: English \" & MBS( \"SyntaxColoring.RemoveTag\" ; $Command_EN ) & \rCase( _Syntax::_gLanguage <> \"English\" and not IsEmpty( $Command_Foreign ) ;\r  \", \" & _Syntax::_gLanguage & \" \" & MBS( \"SyntaxColoring.RemoveTag\" ; $Command_Foreign )\r) ;\r\r$CommandColoringOn and $ColorExists ;\rvStamp & \" Added: English \" & MBS( \"SyntaxColoring.AddTag\" ; $Command_EN ; $ColorHex ) & \rCase( _Syntax::_gLanguage ≠ \"English\" and not IsEmpty( $Command_Foreign ) ;\r  \", \" & _Syntax::_gLanguage & \" \" & MBS( \"SyntaxColoring.AddTag\" ; $Command_Foreign ; $ColorHex )\r) ;\r\r\"-\"\r\r))*/",
    "repetition": "1",
    "flags": 16388
   },
